test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Once in a blue moon
solution:
The correct answer is **__"Rarely".__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An** I**diom is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words .
 
• The Idiom **Once in a blue moon** means to do something rarely.
 
• Examp
